segments.name: IMG
segments.description: Runs sports marketing, media rights sales, content production and On Location premium hospitality experiences for rights holders, brands and event attendees.
segments.evidence: The IMG segment reflects the operations of the following businesses:

revenueModel.text: Media, cable and streaming partners pay media rights fees, fans pay for tickets and hospitality, sponsors pay for partnerships, and licensees pay consumer products royalties.
revenueModel.evidence: TKO primarily generates revenue via domestic and international media rights fees, production services and studio fees, ticket sales at live events, hospitality sales and site fees, partnerships and marketing, and consumer products licensing.

changes.text: In 2025 the company added IMG as a third reportable segment alongside UFC and WWE, following the Endeavor Asset Acquisition.

changes.text: In 2023 the businesses of UFC and WWE were combined under TKO Group Holdings.
